Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from the final game of this ODI series. The action between Bangladesh and Afghanistan now moves to Dhaka for the T20I series. The first T20I will be played on 3rd March 2022 and the game is set to begin at 2:30 pm IST (9:00 am GMT). But do join us early for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the skipper of Afghanistan, says he is proud of how his side played after losing the first two games. Mentions it was not easy to bat early on and he was happy with Tamim Iqbal's decision at the toss. Credits Fazalhaq Farooqi for the way he has bowled and adds Rahmanullah Gurbaz was exceptional. Also credits Rashid Khan and Mohammad Nabi for how they bowled and says they changed the game.

Liton Das is the MAN OF THE SERIES. He says he is disappointed with the team losing but he is happy with how he played but adds it would have been better had they won. Mentions in his mind he wanted to bat for 35 overs but if he did bat longer, it could have been a lot better. Adds he loves batting and he is doing it well. Ends by saying he would dedicate this award to his wife.

Rahmanullah Gurbaz is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says he had an injury in the last game but he recovered well and he was fine in this game. Adds they lost the series but this game they played really well. Mentions his team needs a ton from him and every time he is set, he looks to bat long. States the others also batted well, he was under pressure in the first three overs but they played really well and took the pressure off him. Ends by saying he is looking forward to the games coming ahead.

Tamim Iqbal, the skipper of Bangladesh says that he is very disappointed as he wanted to finish the series on a high, says that they started well, but could not finish well. Mentions that Liton Das got out at the wrong time since he was set. States that this was an important game even though they have won the series, they wanted to grab 10 points. Informs that they did all the hard work, but he credits all the Afghanistan players for their performance.
... PRESENTATION TIME ...

The Bangladesh bowlers needed wickets early on but they failed to do so. They did get three but by that time, it was quite late. The wicket too seemed to have eased out a lot in the second innings and batting seemed a lot easier. Bangladesh just did not have enough runs on the board and they were at least 50 short of what could have been a competitive total.

First, it was their bowlers who not only got back into the game but set the victory up after bowling the hosts out only for 192. Let me remind you Bangladesh were around 100 for 1 and from there, they were bundled out for a low score. Then, their batters batted brilliantly, Gurbaz was the star man for them and he received good support from Rahmat Shah and Riaz Hassan. Both fell but Rahmanullah Gurbaz hung in till the end and took his side over the line with a ton.

A thumping consolation win for Afghanistan then! Had it not been for Afif and Mehidy's heroics in the first ODI, they could have won the series but the visitors will be mighty pleased with how good they played in this game.

Flatter ball, on the pads. Rahmat Shah taps it towards square leg and scampers through to the other end. The fielder there collects the ball and throws it directly on the stumps at the bowler's end, but Rahmanullah Gurbaz is well in. Afghanistan win by 7 wickets!
Another fuller ball, outside off. Najibullah Zadran pushes it to the fielder at mid off. He is in no rush here!
Tosses it up, around off, fuller ball. Najibullah Zadran pushes it back to the bowler.
A full toss, on off. Najibullah Zadran knocks it to cover.
Loopy ball, around off, fuller in length. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards point for a single. Scores are level!
Fuller again, around off. Najibullah Zadran eases it towards mid off. The fielder there fumbles and the batters sneak in a run.
Loopy ball, full and around off. Najibullah Zadran pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Shot! Mustafizur Rahman drops this short, very slow on this occasion, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz waits for it and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Afghanistan need just 3 runs now!
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards point.
Wide! Fuller now, wide of off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leaves it alone. Wide called!
Another length delivery, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it out.
Good-length delivery, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out.
Mustafizur Rahman drops it short now, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to pull but he misses.

100 for Rahmanullah Gurbaz! His third ODI century in just 9 innings! A much-deserved ton from him! Length ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards point and runs across to the other end. A misfield by the fielder there, allows them to come back for a second run.
Drifting it on middle, Najibullah Zadran blocks it out.
Loopy ball, on middle. Najibullah Zadran blocks it out.
Sharp spin! Mehidy Hasan is causing problems towards the end! A fuller, ball, this one lands around off and spins away sharply outside off. Najibullah Zadran swings and fails to get any bat on it.

OUT! LBW! Mehidy Hasan gets his man this time! Hashmatullah Shahidi walks back to the hut early and Mehidy Hasan has grabbed his second wicket. A loopy ball, fuller, on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi gets down on his knee and looks to sweep this but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pad. The umpire raises his finger after an appeal. Hashmatullah Shahidi opts for a review! the replays roll in. No bat involved confirms UltraEdge and Ball Tracker shows three reds! Hashmatullah Shahidi has to depart!

NOT OUT! An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! Slower through the air, full and this one lands around middle and turns away just a tad. Hashmatullah Shahidi steps down the pitch and looks to block this, but his bat is behind his pad and the ball hits the front pad first. Bangladesh opts for a review! Ball Tracker shows it is the umpire's call on impact. The on-field decision stands!
Quicker now, flatter, on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi backs away and cuts it towards point.
Full, around middle and leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Length ball, angling in, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi nudges it towards square leg.
Full again, on off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pushes it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end.
Quick single! Fuller now, around middle and leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi works it away towards square leg for a single.
On a length, darting it on the pads. Hashmatullah Shahidi flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter ball, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.

OUT! STUMPED! Mehidy Hasan strikes! A bit late for Bangladesh! But, Rahmat Shah has to depart now! A fuller ball, outside off. An arm ball by Mehidy Hasan here! Rahmat Shah steps down and tries to flick on the leg side, but he misses it completely. Mushfiqur Rahim grabs the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. Hashmatullah Shahidi walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: st Mushfiqur Rahim b Mehidy Hasan

pitches it up again, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out. 26 more needed!

Fuller ball, on middle. Rahmat Shah leans and defends it out.
DRINKS! Afghanistan are cruising along nicely here! They are just 35 runs away now. This has been a good partnership for Afghanistan. Luck has favoured them too here!

Tosses it up, full and on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leans and taps it to square leg for a single.

Loopy ball, on middle, on a fuller length. Rahmat Shah blocks it out.

Tosses it up, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz knocks it to long off for a single.
Slower through the air now, full, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz eases it to long off for a single.
Shorter, flatter and quicker, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz knocks it towards cover.
Quicker now, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out.
Flatter and shorter, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays in his crease and defends it out.
Loopy ball, full, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out.

Rahim is down on the ground and in a lot of pain. He might have fallen awkwardly while going for that catch. The physio is out. Rahim is doing fine now and is ready continue.

Loopy ball, fuller, outside off. Rahmat Shah blocks it out.

A single to end! On the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one.

DROPPED! That should have been taken, especially when you are chasing the game. Sums Bangladesh's game up! Shorter and down the leg side, Gurbaz looks to pull, it goes off the glove to the left of Rahim who dives and gets to it but spills it.

On middle, defended.

Rahmanullah Gurbaz takes the aerial route again! Another fuller ball, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz once again sweeps it towards the vacant deep mid-wicket region. The fielder from deep square leg runs towards the ball and uses his feet to keep the ball away from the ropes. Three taken! FIFTY for Rahmanullah Gurbaz. It's been great from him so far, but he will want to stay till the end and guide Afghanistan home.
Quicker now, around off, flatter ball as well. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and looks to cut this away, but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tosses this one up, fuller ball, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah knocks it towards cover for a single.

In the air....but safe! Fuller ball, tosses it up again, around middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets down on his knee to sweep this, but the ball goes off the top edge towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs from deep square leg and does well to keep the ball away from the boundary ropes. Three taken!

Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket. A tidy over by Taskin Ahmed!
Back of a length, outside off again. Rahmanullah Gurbaz taps it towards point.

Back of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah stays in his crease and taps it with soft hands towards point for a single.
On a length now, shaping away, outside off. Rahmat Shah lets that go through.
Full in length, outside off. Rahmat Shah drives it towards mid off. No run taken!
Quicker now, on middle, short in length. Rahmanullah Gurbaz blocks it out. Finally, a successful over for Bangladesh!
Shorter now, around middle and leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz works it away towards fine leg for a brace.
Slower through the air, fuller ball, outside off. Rahmat Shah drives it uppishly past the silly point fielder for a single.

DRINKS! That wicket has given Bangladesh a sniff to get back into the game. However, they need more wickets and that too quickly. Afghanistan on the other hand, know that another partnership should seal the deal for them.

OUT! STUMPED! Bangladesh have their first breakthrough! Shakib Al Hasan strikes and draws first blood! A fine innings comes to an end! A loopy ball, full in length, this one lands and turns away outside off. Riaz Hassan presses forward to drive this but gets beaten on the outside edge as the ball spins away. Mushfiqur Rahim collects the ball and watches he batters leg and whips the bails off. The replay shows Riaz Hassan's back leg in just on the line and he has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: st Mushfiqur Rahim b Shakib Al Hasan
